source: Claude, d'après l'arbre du dépôt et le README
explication_en: LivyServer manages the interactive and batch sessions exposed over REST. An interactive session drives an RSCClient that communicates by RPC with the RSCDriver, which runs the code via ReplDriver on Spark.
